::: {.callout-note}
## Conflicting or unsettled dates
The commissioning brief asks this archive to accommodate CSIL design or authorization around **1993**, a pilot around **1994**, and later disagreement about which year counts as a start. This page does not choose between 1993 and 1994.
:::

## What this chapter is for

Later work can separate, with citations:

- program design and ministry authorization
- a pilot
- province-wide availability
- later retrospective start dates

Those may be different events. They should not be merged in prose until sources are inspected.

## Evidence status

- **Documented facts:** none from 1993–95 ministry files. Those records remain [wanted](../sources/wanted-ministry-csil-pilot-records.qmd).
- **Later official chronology:** [Ombudsperson, *Best of Care* Part 2 (2012)](../sources/2012-ombudsperson-best-of-care.qmd) — pilot 1994, province-wide 1995.
- **Later speaker/org attributions:** [Gauthier 2014](../sources/2014-gauthier-sci-csil-presentation.qmd) (established 1993; 50-person pilot); [Gauthier 2015](../sources/2015-gauthier-csil-module-1.qmd) and [IFRC Our Team](../sources/ifrc-our-team.qmd) (1994).
- **Contemporaneous newspaper (inspected):** [HEU *Guardian* Nov/Dec 1995](../sources/1995-heu-guardian-novdec.qmd) — CSIL as a new/pilot Community Support Branch / Continuing Care Division program.
- **Conflicting evidence to preserve:** 1993 versus 1994 as a CSIL starting year; “established” versus piloted 1994 / province-wide 1995. Do not pick a winner here.
- **Open questions:** what “start” refers to in each account; Continuing Care Division / Community Support Branch as administrative home; ECPM as formal predecessor versus later reconstruction.
